svg.title: Durable LumaQuote agent graph
svg.desc: Extraction reads the latest customer turn. Without paid AI only a complete positive written order confirms. With paid AI the model reads the conversation and writes the reply, but only a deterministic YES to a code-built restatement, or a written order the model agrees with, confirms. Unconfirmed, negated or missing requirements create a durable clarification intent and customer interrupt. Confirmed explicit lines call the backend draft service and pause for a persisted staff decision when a quote exists. No graph node sends a message.
